projects.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Needed in Chennai
projects.description:
Freelancer Required: Full-Stack Web Developer

I’m looking for a capable full-stack web developer based in Chennai to help build and deploy a web-based platform. The ideal candidate should have experience developing secure, scalable applications with multiple user roles, database-driven workflows, dashboards, and a clean, responsive user interface.

Required skills:
- Frontend development using React or a similar modern framework.
- Backend development using Python (FastAPI preferred) or an equivalent framework.
- Database design and integration, preferably MySQL or PostgreSQL.
- Authentication, role-based access control, and secure API development.
- File and image uploads, search, filtering, and status tracking.
- Third-party API integrations and workflow automation.
- Deployment, testing, debugging, and production readines

What I’m looking for:
Someone based in Chennai who can work with an existing or partially developed codebase, understand requirements, build reliable end-to-end features, and deliver a functional, production-ready application. The ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and maintain clean, well-documented code is important.

Please share your portfolio, relevant projects, preferred technology stack, estimated timeline, and quotation.

Further project details and requirements will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

projects.title: Logistics & Multi-AI Integration Developer
projects.description:
Title:
Independent Full-Time Remote Developer (Logistics Tech & Multi-AI Integration) – India Only
Job Description:
I am looking to hire one individual independent software engineer based in India for a long-term, remote role. I already have one engineer on my team working under this exact model, and I am looking to expand. You will work with me directly to build, maintain, and optimize software systems tailored for the logistics, trucking, and supply chain industry.
The Deal:
• Type: Independent Freelancer Only (Strictly NO agencies, NO dev shops, NO account managers).
• Hours: 160 hours per month (Full-time dedication).
• Budget: $2,000 USD fixed monthly retainer ($12.50/hr equivalent).
What you will be doing:
• Multi-AI & Automation Integration: Building and integrating AI tools across multiple ecosystems (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPTs, DeepSeek, and open-source models) to automate complex workflows (e.g., parsing carrier rate sheets, tracking PDFs, or automating broker emails).
• Logistics Tech Management: Building and updating software tailored for logistics (TMS systems, route optimization, driver dispatching apps, or carrier dashboards).
• Full Stack Maintenance: Writing clean backend code (Python, Node.js, etc.), managing databases, and connecting third-party mapping, SMS, or tracking APIs.
Requirements (Must be proficient in all software/tools below):
• AI & LLM Stacks: Mastery of major AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek). Deep understanding of prompt engineering, function calling, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, and AI frameworks (LangChain or LlamaIndex).
• AI Coding Tools: High proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to ship high-quality code incredibly fast.
• Core Development Stack: Mastery of backend stacks (e.g., Python/FastAPI or Node.js) and database management (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB).
• Logistics & Location Software: Deep familiarity with mapping/routing APIs (Google Maps API, Mapbox, or OpenStreetMap) and handling real-time telemetry/tracking data.
• Communication & Dev Ops: Fluent English, Git/GitHub proficiency, and the independence to push clean code daily without needing a project manager to hold your hand.
To Apply:
Please start your application with the exact phrase "LOGISTICS DIRECT - 160 MULTI-AI" so I know you read this entirely. In your reply, briefly list 2 relevant logistics or AI integration projects you have personally built from scratch.

projects.title: Cross-Platform Prediction Bot Development
projects.description:
I want to build a prediction bot that works seamlessly on the web, mobile, and desktop. The heart of the project is automated data analysis: the system should pull fresh data from the sources we define, process it with a machine-learning model, and publish clear, up-to-date predictions without any manual touch-points.

To make sure the bot is portable, I’m open to the tech stack you feel is best—Python with TensorFlow or PyTorch for the model, a Node.js or FastAPI back end, and a front end that can compile to the browser, iOS/Android, and Windows/macOS (React, React Native, Flutter, or Electron are all fine). Stability, maintainability, and clean documentation matter more to me than the exact framework.

Deliverables  
• Architecture and stack proposal geared toward web, mobile, and desktop deployment  
• Data pipeline that ingests, cleans, and stores incoming data automatically  
• Trained or integrated ML model that produces reliable predictions on a schedule (or in real time if feasible)  
• Lightweight UI for each platform showing current and historical prediction outputs  
• Clear build/run instructions, plus guidance on retraining or swapping the model later

Acceptance criteria  
1. One codebase (or tightly coupled modules) that deploys to all three platforms.  
2. End-to-end automation from data retrieval through to on-screen prediction.  
3. Unit tests covering key data-handling and prediction logic.

Please share examples of past predictive-analytics projects, the libraries you prefer for cross-platform work, and a rough timeline. I’m ready to get started as soon as we align on the approach.

projects.title: Model Prediksi Tren Bisnis Industri
projects.description:
Saya membutuhkan seorang ahli machine learning untuk membangun model prediksi yang memetakan tren bisnis berdasarkan data pasar industri. Fokusnya adalah analisis tren bisnis, bukan evaluasi keuangan atau peramalan permintaan semata.  

Alur kerja yang saya bayangkan:  
• Mengumpulkan dan membersihkan data pasar industri yang sudah saya sediakan dalam format CSV.  
• Mengeksplorasi pola historis lalu merancang fitur relevan.  
• Melatih model prediksi—boleh menggunakan Python dengan scikit-learn, TensorFlow, atau framework serupa—hingga akurasi tercapai secara konsisten di atas baseline.  
• Mempresentasikan hasil lewat notebook interaktif dan ringkasan temuan agar mudah saya pahami.  

Silakan sertakan pengalaman Anda menangani proyek serupa, pendekatan evaluasi performa yang biasa dipakai (mis. MAE, RMSE, atau metrik lain), dan perkiraan waktu penyelesaian. Jika punya ide untuk meningkatkan insight, saya terbuka mendiskusikannya.

projects.description:
I’m putting together a small, dedicated relationship with an AI developer who can stay on board for the long haul. The exact use cases will grow and shift over time, but the common thread is building production-ready AI features—from architecting models and pipelines to deploying them, monitoring performance, and iterating based on real-world feedback.  


I NEED A THINKER

SOMEONE THAT HAS THE INTELLIGENCE TO WORK WITH US SO WE CAN GET OUR IDEA TO 100%

SO WE HAVE A HUGE TASK AHEAD TO WELCOME EVERY JUNIOUR SPORTS TEAM TO OUR WEBSITE.

IF YOU CAN SEE A FUTURE AND YOU WANT TO EARN BONUSES ON TOP OF OUR AGREED MONTHLY RETAINER then we welcome your enquiry 

But if you cannot see yourself accepting our terms

Then please do not apply.




Initially, I’ll share a backlog of tasks experimenting with different model architectures to integrating trained models into existing web and mobile products. 







You should be able to move comfortably between data wrangling, model training, and API integration, ideally using Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus the usual MLOps stack (Docker, Git, cloud services). Solid communication is crucial because you and I will plan sprints together, review results, and adjust priorities quickly.  

Acceptance criteria for each milestone will be straightforward: reproducible code in a private repo, clear documentation, and a short demo video or live session that proves the feature works as intended. If that sounds like your kind of partnership, let’s start with a small paid test and grow from there.
